name: Jellyfin Audio Transcoding Control
description: Experimental AC3 audio policies for explicitly selected devices and users. Disabled by default; native dashboard configuration and sanitized diagnostics.
overview: Experimental ordered device/user AC3 policies and native dashboard configuration.

versions.changelog: Inline full-width expandable rule cards with retained unsaved edits. Fix covered overflow actions, stable-ID deletion and native confirmation. Separate management from activation/save validation; preserve disabled drafts and empty rule lists. Add bounded action diagnostics. Playback, identity binding, permissions and video processing unchanged.

Verify native credential association across header and token-registration device identities; revalidate current audio tracks, policies and permissions. Preserve compatible AC3 direct play and video processing. Redesign the scoped native dashboard and device registration presentation with explicit assignment confirmation. Real Fire TV/receiver verification remains pending.

Separate authenticated device identity from native progressive routing DeviceId; accept only exact authenticated or same-context native-issued transport values. Preserve all session/rule/source/track/permission and video checks. Add pseudonymized per-field identity diagnostics and versioned dashboard resources with actual client UI build reporting. Exact productive Fire TV mismatch remains unobserved; unexplained differences safely bypass.

Fix audio-only permission source rejection and unique implicit-source selection; support negotiated progressive MKV AC3 with native video copy policy. Add searchable checkbox selections, field-specific validation and actual HTTP status diagnostics. Schema 2 and GUID unchanged; real Fire TV playback remains to be verified.

Dashboard hotfix: fix native Jellyfin Web 10.11.11 device loading; recoverable initialization, direct Plugins sidebar entry, localized errors and sanitized frontend/server diagnostics. Schema 2 and playback policies unchanged.

Ordered multi-device/user AC3 rules, lossless legacy migration, native English/German configuration and structured diagnostics. Experimental; real-device playback and native update validation remain pending.
Initial experimental AC3 prototype. Manual configuration required; real-device playback not yet validated.
